source_paper.title: GIFT: LLM-Guided State-Reward Interface for Financial Reinforcement Learning

paper_keywords: Rather than using the LLM to make trading decisions
coverage.policy: LLM may propose state/reward interfaces only; no direct actions or target weights.
Allowed feature primitives are append-only, bounded, and point-in-time guarded.
Reward terms are evaluated offline and cannot emit executable targets.
DGR is approximated with offline diagnostics; PPO training remains blocked without signed approval.

paper_keywords: fixes the selected state-reward interface before evaluation
coverage.policy: Interfaces are frozen before OOS review; test-time LLM updates are rejected.
Coverage is research-only and feeds manual review, not live allocation.
Signed human approval is mandatory before any training queue or promotion path.
Research availability never overrides deployment consistency or live-trading guards.

decision.summary: Research shadow diagnostics do not permit 00631L add: at least one research-only readiness, volatility-memory, systemic bubble time-at-risk, HMM-WJ scenario-readiness, illiquidity-network readiness, speculative-influence-network readiness, SIN-lite proxy, dynamic CVaR tail/cost diagnostic, synthetic augmentation validation gate, or intervention fatigue/risk-budget gate, LETF tracking-error/effective-fee gate, Asian ETF tail-analytics gate, reduced-rank correlation readiness, RL governance, or LLM state-reward interface readiness is blocked.
Deployment-consistency review is diagnostic only. It may block or force manual review, but it never changes GroupA+ target weights.
